effects.name: Exhaustion Levels
effects.text: This condition is cumulative. Each time you receive it, you gain 1 Exhaustion level. You die if your Exhaustion level is 6.

effects.name: D20 Tests Affected
effects.text: When you make a D20 Test, the roll is reduced by 2 times your Exhaustion level.

effects.name: Speed Reduced
effects.text: Your Speed is reduced by a number of feet equal to 5 times your Exhaustion level.

effects.name: Removing Exhaustion Levels
effects.text: Finishing a Long Rest removes 1 of your Exhaustion levels. When your Exhaustion level reaches 0, the condition ends.
